channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: NHL Draft Prospect Gavin McKenna's Felony Charge Withdrawn, Still Faces Three Charges
item.description: NHL draft prospect Gavin McKenna still faces three charges after allegedly punching a 21-year-old man twice, but the aggravated assault charge was withdrawn.

item.title: Could These 10 NHL Veterans Be Playing In Their Last Olympics?
item.description: Longtime NHL veterans, such as Canada's Sidney Crosby and Denmark's Lars Eller, will play crucial roles for their national team at the 2026 Olympics. But will this be their final chance to win an Olympic medal?

item.title: Hockey Canada Picking Seth Jarvis Over Zach Hyman Was An Easy Choice
item.description: Team Canada made another change due to Brayden Point's injury. Adding Carolina Hurricanes star Seth Jarvis instead of Edmonton Oilers winger Zach Hyman is the right decision.

item.title: William Nylander Faces Career-Defining Moments With Sweden And Maple Leafs
item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs star winger William Nylander is facing immense pressure on two fronts this year: in the NHL with the Maple Leafs, and at the 2026 Olympics with Team Sweden.

item.title: Olympic Gold And A Stanley Cup Would Fast-Track Wild GM Bill Guerin To The Hall Of Fame
item.description: Minnesota Wild GM Bill Guerin could pull off an unprecedented achievement in 2026 – leading the Wild to a Stanley Cup win, and putting together a U.S. team that wins an OIympic gold medal in the same calendar year. Can Guerin's two teams thrive in two ultimate high-pressure challenges?

item.title: Oilers' Quinn Hutson's Hard Working Mentality Highlights Hutson Family Influence In The NHL
item.description: Quinn Hutson's story may be different from those of his younger brothers Lane and Cole, but the Hutson family's influence in the NHL is growing stronger, thanks to the hard work and determination displayed by Quinn.

item.title: 'It Starts With Coaches'; Should Kris Knoblauch's Job As The Oilers' Coach Be In Jeopardy?
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers headed into the Olympic Break on a losing skid, and star center Leon Draisaitl's pointed comments about the team needing improvement include coach Kris Knoblauch. If the Oilers don't turn things around soon, will Knoblauch's job security be jeopardized?

item.title: Hey, New York Rangers, Here's Your Future
item.description: Following the blockbuster Artemi Panarin trade, Liam Greentree has become one of the most important players within the New York Rangers organization, as he headlines a new future.

item.title: Countries With NHL Players Who Won't Be Playing In The 2026 Olympics
item.description: The 2026 Olympics will feature over 100 NHL players, but many stars won't attend because their countries have been banned or didn't qualify.

item.title: 'John Will Be Right There'; Gaudreau Family Pens Touching Letter As Team USA Prepares For The Olympics
item.description: Team USA is chasing Olympic gold at the 2026 Games, and they have a profound, bittersweet motivation: honoring the lives of the late Johnny Gaudreau and his brother, Matthew.
